mechanism: Both agents increase skin irritation, photosensitivity, and teratogenic risk; tazarotene is a retinoid that enhances corticosteroid-induced atrophy and may increase systemic absorption when combined.
action: Use with caution in topical applications; avoid concurrent use on same skin areas; counsel on strict sun protection, contraception (tazarotene is highly teratogenic), and monitor for excessive skin irritation or atrophy.
